Definition: prolonged form of a more primary κεράω (which is used in certain tenses); to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking):--fill, pour out. Compare G3396.
BiblicalUsage: Kerannymi means to mingle, to pour out mixed. Revelation 14:10 says the wine of the wrath of God is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation, and Revelation 18:6 says in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's wrath is unmixed and full measure, and that is why I want my cup filled with his mercy instead.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
